exposure_anchors.1: Negligible: payroll-only operation, no subcontractors / suppliers, low-VAT.
exposure_anchors.2: Limited: small supplier base, no cash payments, no subcontracted labour.
exposure_anchors.3: Moderate: regular use of subcontractors or VAT-eligible suppliers; occasional cash.
exposure_anchors.4: High: significant subcontracted labour or supplier book; cash component; international supply chain.
exposure_anchors.5: Severe: labour-intensive sector (construction, hospitality, agriculture) with informal payment culture; high-VAT goods sector.

threat_credibility_anchors.1: No documented enforcement in this profile.
threat_credibility_anchors.2: Documented but rare CFA / equivalent enforcement.
threat_credibility_anchors.3: Active enforcement in the sector / region.
threat_credibility_anchors.4: Active and adapted: peers prosecuted; HMRC / equivalent bulletins.
threat_credibility_anchors.5: Active and targeted: prior CFA enforcement contact or sector listed as priority.

vulnerability_anchors.1: Reasonable Procedures complete + audited; supplier and subbie controls evidenced.
vulnerability_anchors.2: Programme broadly in place with minor gaps.
vulnerability_anchors.3: Programme partial: subbie / supplier checks inconsistent; training thin.
vulnerability_anchors.4: Programme weak: cash payments common; no counterparty DD on high-VAT.
vulnerability_anchors.5: No programme; reliance on individual judgement; no risk assessment.
